claims.text: Several reviewers report the device stopped working after short use, including units that failed within days or months.
Some reviewers received units that arrived dirty or appeared previously used.
Many reviewers praise the brush's effectiveness, saying it cleans and exfoliates well and leaves skin smoother.
Reviewers frequently mention the sturdy, nice-looking case and variety of brush heads as positives.
Some reviewers find the brush lacks power, with the motor stopping under light pressure or feeling weak compared to competitors.
